definitions.explanation: Refusing to change one's mind, attitude, or position despite pressure or persuasion. Often carries a negative connotation of inflexibility, but can sometimes suggest admirable steadfastness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頑|かたく}な⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{拒否|きょひ}した→拒否する：21331_kyohisuru⟧。
{頑|かたく}なな⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}さ→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧ず、⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難航|なんこう}した→難航する：19360_nankousuru⟧。
examples.english: Negotiations struggled because they wouldn't budge from their stubborn stance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{頑|かたく}な⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{守|まも}り→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{手作業|てさぎょう}→手作業：12767_tesagyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っていた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather stubbornly adhered to traditional methods and made things by hand until the very end.

notes:
USAGE:
{頑|かたく}な is a na-adjective. It is commonly used in the adverbial form {頑|かたく}な⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to modify verbs meaning to refuse, insist, or maintain a position. It usually has a negative connotation (inflexibility), but context can make it positive (steadfast commitment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頑|かたく}な⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{拒否|きょひ}する→拒否する：21331_kyohisuru⟧ (to stubbornly refuse)
- {頑|かたく}な⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (to stubbornly protect/uphold)
- {頑|かたく}なな⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (a stubborn attitude)
- {頑|かたく}なな⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧ (a rigid stance)
- {頑|かたく}な⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{否定|ひてい}する→否定する：06063_hiteisuru⟧ (to stubbornly deny)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頑|かたく}な: stubborn, rigid (refusing to change; often negative)
- ⟦{頑固|がんこ}→頑固：06643_ganko⟧: stubborn (strong-willed; can be positive or negative)
- {意固地|いこじ}: obstinate, perverse (childishly stubborn)
- ⟦{強情|ごうじょう}→強情：18243_goujou⟧: headstrong, willful (refusal to yield)
